populationPolicy: From the immutable 307-row v3 focus-grammar-killer queue, exclude only the 38 frozen blank-v2 operational dev/confirmatory/reserve memberships and the complete transitive cluster under the frozen exact/normalized/near-duplicate policy; then preserve queue order.
